name: Wondy World
summary: Wondy World is a 2D platform adventure with six worlds (Tutorial World, Eternal Spring, Desert, Tundra & Ice, Happy Candy and Final Fire) and a creative mode to build and share levels. The level editor will not save a level without at least 25 coins and 10 enemies.
